IAR-DD-04.title: revealAndExecute has no access control — front-running break

escalation.detail:
OK: EscalationHunter executed — verdict: ESCALATES to HIGH. revealAndExecute without ACL breaks the STATED PURPOSE of commit-reveal
(L565: "keep calldata secret for swaps"). MEV extraction + DoS of message delivery.
multicall has onlyOwner, setCommitment has onlyOwner, but revealAndExecute has NONE.
This inconsistency is clearly a bug, not a design choice.
Deployed on Polygon: OwnableMulticall per-ICA, callRemoteCommitReveal selector exists.

IAR-DD-02.title: callRemoteCommitReveal drains router ETH balance via address

escalation.detail:
OK: EscalationHunter executed — verdict: MAINTAINS MEDIUM. Inter-user value leak via address(this).balance in reveal dispatch.
Pre-existing ETH consumed by subsequent callers. Magnitude depends on ETH accumulation
in router. receive() is open, so anyone can force-deposit. But per-tx amount is bounded
by what's in the router at time of callRemoteCommitReveal.
